description: Referrals: referrers, referrals, overrides, steps, imports; typed models and reward amounts (SPEC 28)

cases.description: get_or_create_referrer posts customer_user_id (the customer ID) and the optional fields; 201 gives created true
An existing referrer answers 200: created false; external_code is sent when given
An empty customer ID is refused locally with invalid_argument
get_referrer fetches one referrer
get_referrer maps 404 to NotFoundError
find_referrer with a customer ID uses the by-user route
find_referrer with a code uses the by-code route; the path is percent-encoded
find_referrer returns null on 404 instead of throwing
Only 404 becomes null: a 401 still throws AuthenticationError
find_referrer needs exactly one of customer_id and code (invalid_argument, nothing sent)
get fetches a referral; every reward side with amount_minor and currency gains amount in normal units
amount uses the currency exponent: JPY has no minor digits, KWD three; the currency is matched case-insensitively
A referral without reward information has no reward_snapshot
list follows next_cursor with starting_after; referee_customer_id is sent as referee_customer_user_id and dates as RFC 3339
Pages are fetched lazily: taking 1 referral makes 1 request
list_page returns one page with typed referrals
qualify posts the override with action qualify and the reason
disqualify posts the override with action disqualify and the reason
complete_step sends the goal, occurred_at (RFC 3339 UTC), the value as a decimal string and the currency
occurred_at is required (the API requires it): missing, it is refused locally with invalid_argument and nothing is sent
An explicit occurred_at is formatted as RFC 3339 UTC
A negative value is refused locally (invalid_value, SPEC 8)
import_referrers splits rows into batches of 1000, one request each with its own idempotency key, and returns the jobs in order
An empty list sends nothing and returns no jobs
block_referrer posts the reason; without one the body is an empty object
unblock_referrer posts without a body
update_referrer patches display_name and attributes (a free-form map)
Writes use the shared retry and idempotency rules: a 503 is retried with the same key
Unknown referrer and referral fields are kept (forward compatibility)
